verdict.rationale: Keycloak can be started non-interactively from a container image, with the bootstrap admin set via environment variables [keycloak-docs-2, keycloak-docs-45]. It can be administered by script through the kcadm.sh Admin CLI and the Admin REST API [kc-supp-kcadm, keycloak-docs-6], seeded via JSON realm import/export and operator-driven realm import and declarative clients [keycloak-docs-10, keycloak-docs-76, keycloak-docs-43], and gated in pipelines using health endpoints and client-credentials service accounts [keycloak-docs-17, kc-supp-client-credentials]. Hands-on reports describe friction with infrastructure-as-code: configuration lives in the database, the API is hard to keep idempotent, and slow warm-up makes it ill-suited to ephemeral runs [keycloak-comm-3, keycloak-comm-13, keycloak-comm-19]. Missing for 10: a documented CI-specific workflow guide, idempotent declarative config-as-code outside the operator, a published OpenAPI spec at the probed paths [keycloak-probe-3], and independent corroboration of smooth CI use.
